description:
The night believed to be over is not yet over. The memories of that day, sealed by death and disappearance, breathe quietly in the darkness. The vanished friend Woo-Jin, the distorted truth, and the traces someone tried to erase. The protagonist, Kyung-Su, steps into the deepest part of the night. Without turning away or retreating, he moves forward toward the end of the truth. The anger and determination accumulated in the silence soon become action, and the darkness can no longer hide. What is revealed after digging to the very end is the truth obscured by the night and the price it pays.

(Source: Naver, translated)
